readerInvitation.closingInvitation: Begin with the author’s note and the method explaining what the models can show. Then follow the distinction between selection and the contract that continues after selection. The full inquiry tests the conditions under which honorable leadership could remain genuinely removable. Its value lies in examining how privilege might end without turning correction into destruction. Read the human coda to confront the unresolved burden that elegant institutional models leave behind.

emotionalPlan.arc: First frustration at blocked scrutiny, then anxiety at permanent audition; neither extreme earns a triumphant verdict.
emotionalPlan.purpose: The source's comparison asks what due process and independent evidence change.
emotionalPlan.motion: Use two sequential views of the same unfinished bridge and planning office, not parallel generic icons. First an engineer’s warning is filed in an archive whose only key remains with the incumbent. A reviewer requests it and receives a curated progress picture while the actual warning remains visible behind the office partition. Then reset as a second hypothetical contract: the leader is repeatedly called away from the long work plan to defend each contested step, work crews remain waiting beside unplaced structural sections, and the schedule cannot advance. Do not use a floating bell, empty stamped paper or an invented numerical model chart. The contrast is between unusable review and action-destroying interruption; do not imply every protest or adverse review is illegitimate.

scenes.alt: Two sequential hypothetical rules govern the same long bridge project: a captured archive produces only curated progress for review; after a visible reset, permanent audition repeatedly pulls a leader away while workers and unplaced sections remain waiting. This does not portray all opposition as illegitimate or establish any real person’s guilt.

emotionalPlan.motion: Change to a close independent project archive and review encounter. The engineer deposits the same warning in an independently held record; the incumbent cannot remove it. A pre-existing review condition is consulted, then the officeholder supplies an answer alongside the preserved evidence, rather than receiving an instant guilty stamp. Keep explanation and deliberate destruction of records visually distinct: an attempted missing-page edit cannot alter the retained copy. Show a possible end of mandate through return of the office access badge, while the person takes personal belongings and joins ordinary family or civic life; avoid harm to relatives or confiscating unrelated possessions. Review is explicitly conceptual, not an implemented legal procedure or a declaration that the illustrated leader is guilty. There is no empirical success score.

scenes.alt: A warning enters an independent archive, a previously declared review condition is consulted, and the officeholder adds a reply. The record remains available. A separately marked possible outcome returns only the office badge; the person carries personal belongings into ordinary civic life. No guilty finding, automatic removal, confiscation of unrelated assets or implemented legal procedure is asserted.

emotionalPlan.arc: Recognize finite attention without condescension; end with curiosity and the ability to ask a precise question.
emotionalPlan.purpose: Read it to examine how an accountable office could remain both capable and intelligible.
emotionalPlan.motion: Move to an inhabited evening kitchen: an adult balances paid work and care, faced with a deep pile of public project records. A short explanation of the same bridge mandate becomes a usable entry point: selecting its review condition opens the preserved warning and the named independent reviewer, not an unrelated glossy summary. The official and independent views use the same underlying record; no personalized contradictory truth. A clear appeal route reaches another person. Finish with the book’s actual contract chapter and Human Coda, beside the visible record connection; do not transform complexity into a magic one-click consent or completed legal outcome. This adopts the source’s reversible-explanation relationship without copying its statistical charts.

scenes.alt: In an inhabited evening kitchen, work and care coexist with a thick public record. A short independent-review commitment opens the preserved warning and review condition, with another human available to answer. The record remains shared and inspectable rather than personalized constitutional truth. The final book pages point to the contract chapter and Human Coda, without claiming automatic consent or resolved appeal.
